column3: Let every soul be subject to governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been appointed by God.
Therefore the one who resists the authority has opposed the arrangement of God, and those who oppose will receive judgment on themselves.
For rulers are not a fear to good work but to evil. And do you wish not to fear the authority? Do good, and you will have praise from it,
for it is God’s servant to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid, for it does not bear the sword in vain; for it is God’s servant, an avenger for wrath against the one who practices evil.
Therefore it is necessary to be subject, not only because of wrath but also because of conscience.
For because of this you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God attending continually to this very thing.
Give to all what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, revenue to whom revenue, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.
Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another, for the one who loves the other has fulfilled law.

For “You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not desire,” and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
Love does no evil to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of law.
And this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to awaken from sleep, for now our salvation is nearer than when we believed.
The night has advanced, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us put away the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.
Let us walk properly as in the day, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and sensuality, not in strife and jealousy,
but put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh toward desires.
